column1: The "Immortal Game" was played in London in {n} as a friendly game. Anderssen gave away a bishop, both rooks and finally his queen. Black had a huge material advantage but his pieces were far away from his king. With just two bishops and a knight, White gave mate. Lesson: active pieces near the king are worth more than material on the other side of the board.
column2: Immortal Game {n} mein London mein dostana game ke roop mein khela gaya. Anderssen ne ek bishop, dono rooks aur aakhir mein queen de di. Black ke paas bahut zyada material tha par uske pieces apne king se door the. Sirf do bishops aur ek knight se White ne mate diya. Seekh: king ke paas active pieces board ki doosri taraf ke material se zyada keemti hain.
